proposals.before: By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs did not personally decide major state matters; all lawsuits were handled by the yilibi alone.
proposals.after: By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs never personally decided matters that were not major affairs of state; all lawsuits were handled by the yilibi alone.
proposals.reason: Chinese 非國家重務，未嘗親決 means he did not personally decide non-major affairs, not that he avoided major ones; the idiomatic reverses the scope of 非.

proposals.before: By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs did not personally decide state weighty affairs; all lawsuits were presided over only by the yilibi.
proposals.after: By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs never personally decided affairs that were not weighty state matters; all lawsuits were presided over only by the yilibi.
proposals.reason: Same reversal of 非國家重務 as in the idiomatic: 非 negates 'weighty state affairs' as the class he left undecided personally.

decisions.reason: 非國家重務，未嘗親決 means that for affairs that were not major state matters the commissioner never decided them personally; the original reverses 非 and contradicts s0127, where later commissioners first began hearing lawsuits themselves.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 樞密使非國家重務，未嘗親決

decisions.reason: The same 非 scopes the class left undecided: affairs that were not weighty state matters; the proposed literal restores that negation without changing the rest of the sentence.
